title: Back-up assistant and back-seat mentions
summary: This topic is loosely clustered around back-up assistant use, dealer return phrasing, and a few back-seat or headrest comments rather than one single consistent issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention satisfaction with returning to the brand and a favorable overall ownership impression despite a headrest comfort complaint appearing in the same cluster.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe repeated dealer returns for alerts and a back-up assistant that does not recognize low garage curbs in a parking setting.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are mostly incomplete or context-light mentions of getting the car back, returning to the dealer, menu settings reverting, and back-up assistant references without enough detail to judge sentiment.
